title: Recovery: corrupt artifact, SSE drop, kernel and gateway kill -9
settles: the UI is honest and consistent with the durable files across a corrupt artifact, an SSE drop and kernel/gateway crashes

steps.name: setup: design case R1 through the UI and execute its first item; the artifact is captured
(a) corrupt artifact: bytes edited inside the cell -> typed digest-mismatch card, nothing rendered from the bad bytes; restored afterwards
(d) SSE drop: while the stream is down another session executes; the pill says Reconnecting (no progress), then resumes from the cursor with no duplicate revision
steps.error: Timed out waiting for pill shows Reconnecting while the stream is down
